limitations: Coverage counts candidate depths on frozen visible RGB samples, not confirmed foreground recovery. Background depth behind a stem can occupy the same pixel.
Bare-board occupancy is correct in a full-scene reconstruction and is not a false-surface score. It is kept separate from plant samples.
The fixed source samples are assistant-reviewed and await operator confirmation. +/-3 px annotation uncertainty is reported separately, not silently added to primary coverage.
Short-baseline probes retain existing agreement/range gates but are not yet multi-anchor TSDF/visibility validated.
Depth distributions and colour overlays must be reviewed with coverage. More points or occupancy alone is insufficient.
Conditional P4 landmark evidence shares poses/scale with reconstruction; excluded/ambiguous tracks are not used for scoring.
Histogram bins and a 20 mm common-depth-change diagnostic are descriptive; neither was used to alter reconstruction or calibrate scale.
